snippet.title: A stupid game about pouring drinks for the P.T.A. - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to the a rural english village. The P.T.A. is tasked with organising the Summer Fete but Oh no! They're short of funds.
Step into the shoes of a crafty guy and upsell simple water to raise the funds. If the Fete doesn't happen, you won't get to spend a summer day with the lads.

Check it out on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4185050/A_stupid_game_about_pouring_drinks_for_the_PTA/
